parameters.content:
# Start here
This workflow monitors Upwork jobs, scores them against a **user-owned `profile.md`**, and sends only strong matches to Telegram.

**Before activating:**
1. In **Runtime Settings**, set the raw/public URL of your `profile.md` and your Telegram chat ID.
2. Add an **Upwork OAuth2** credential with permission to read marketplace job postings.
3. Add an **OpenAI** credential to the chat model (or replace the model node with another supported LLM).
4. Add a **Telegram bot** credential.
5. Run the workflow manually once, review the results, then activate the 15-minute schedule.

The workflow automatically creates/reuses the `upwork_seen_jobs` Data Table. Do not place API keys, access tokens, bot tokens, or passwords inside `profile.md`.

## 1. Load and validate the dynamic profile
`profile.md` is the customer configuration layer. It defines search lanes, skills, commercial thresholds, blocked keywords, score thresholds, proposal preferences, and notification rules.

The workflow validates the fenced `profile-config` JSON block, automatically creates the seen-jobs table if needed, and checks whether this profile has run before. No freelancer-specific matching logic is hard-coded in the workflow.

## 2. Search Upwork and remove obvious mismatches
One GraphQL request is generated per search lane in `profile.md`. Results are normalized into a common job object and filtered deterministically before any LLM call.

Hard filters can reject jobs that are too old, below configured hourly/fixed-budget floors, or contain blocked keywords. Duplicate jobs returned by multiple search lanes are collapsed, then previously processed jobs are skipped via the Data Table.

## 3. First-run protection and routing
Jobs that fail deterministic filters are stored as seen without using AI. If `first_run_behavior` is `seed`, all matching jobs discovered on the very first run are also stored without alerts, preventing a flood of historical notifications.

After the baseline exists, only unseen jobs that pass the pre-filter continue to AI scoring.

## 5. Alert only qualified jobs and remember every decision
The configured score threshold decides whether a job is sent to Telegram. High-priority matches receive a stronger visual marker. The alert includes score, age, budget, client signals, risks, screening instructions, and a suggested opening.

Whether alerted, below threshold, seeded, or rejected, every processed job is upserted into `upwork_seen_jobs` so it is not reprocessed on the next scheduled run.

## 4. Score fit and draft a proposal opening
The AI receives the complete user-owned `profile.md` plus the normalized Upwork job payload. It must score conservatively, explain the match, flag risks, capture any screening instruction, and draft a concise proposal opening without inventing experience.

The structured parser enforces a predictable JSON response. Replace the OpenAI model if desired; downstream logic only depends on the structured fields.
